suspended.title: Organization Temporarily Suspended
suspended.message: Your organization has been temporarily suspended. All accounts are on hold until further notice.
suspended.action: If you believe this is an error, contact the platform administrator.

inactive.title: Organization Inactive
inactive.message: Your organization is currently inactive. System access is unavailable at this time.
inactive.action: Contact the platform administrator for reactivation.

archived.title: Organization Archived
archived.message: Your organization has been archived. Data is preserved but access is no longer available.
archived.action: Contact the platform administrator if you need access to your data.

statusUnknown: Organization status is unknown. Please contact the platform administrator.
